sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Lands ~460 ms after the scroll settles; spectrogram shows sustained harmonic bands continuing the music bed, no transient tied to the bubble.

pattern.description: Inside the fixed Cirrus Virtual Agent chat panel, the existing history slides up as a new customer message bubble pushes in from the bottom, clipped by the panel bounds.
pattern.why_premium: Reproduces real chat behaviour with a smooth, short scroll instead of a pop, so the conversation reads as live while the composition around the panel stays still.

build_hint.gsap: Inside an overflow:hidden chat body: gsap.to(chatStack, {y: '-=120', duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) while gsap.from(newBubble, {y: 120, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) on the same timeline label; no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [0, -120], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the message list inside a clipped container; new bubble rides with the list.

notes: b02 covers only the top part of the new bubble (the region that changed); no candidate box spans the full bubble. Treated the agent-side messages as one group (b01) rather than listing nested boxes b03-b07.
